name: Reverse String
description: Reverses a string in-place using two pointers. Swap characters from both ends moving toward the center.
aim: Reverse a string without extra allocation by swapping arr[left] and arr[right] while converging from both ends.
howItWorks: While left < right: swap arr[left] and arr[right]
When they meet/cross: string is reversed

alternatives: Stack-based reversal — O(n) space but same O(n) time
Built-in reverse functions in high-level languages
